site.title: AleDev's Portfolio. Web Developer
site.description: Let's get in touch, together we can create great things. I am a developer with {{years}} years of experience in the world of Web.

about.first: I am a results-oriented Senior Frontend Engineer with over {{years}} years of experience specializing in scalable B2B SaaS applications, advanced web performance optimization, and technical leadership. My core expertise focuses on building robust Design Systems and integrating AI-driven interactive interfaces.
about.second: I graduated in Computer Engineering in 2020 from the University of Matanzas (Cuba), receiving top academic honors and joining the Union of Computer Scientists of Cuba (UIC). As an academic milestone, I co-authored a peer-reviewed scientific article on predictive models published in the DYNA journal. Throughout my career, I have a proven track record of standardizing enterprise component libraries and successfully transforming complex legacy architectures into modern, high-performance React ecosystems.
about.third: I possess a professional upper-intermediate level of English, enabling me to lead global cross-functional engineering teams and collaborate closely with Product and UX/UI stakeholders. I am driven by a deep commitment to code quality, developer experience (DX), and mentoring engineering talent.
about.fourth: I bring a unique combination of technical rigor, leadership experience, and a passion for innovation. I am ready to take on new challenges and deliver immediate value to demanding tech projects.
